description: One faceless athletic male figure reused by every exercise and every camera. Built from the MakeHuman base mesh through MPFB (generated characters are CC0), then made faceless and given shorts by this pipeline.

body_shape.comment: MakeHuman macro sliders (0..1). Muscle definition is the MakeHuman (max muscle - average muscle) shape delta scaled by muscle_definition; leanness adds a fraction of the (minimum weight - chosen weight) delta. Changing any value here creates a NEW character version: bump master_character_id.
body_shape.chosen: Kiệt chose option A on 14/11/2026 (docs/exercise-visual-system/character_options_v3.png): 002 (muscle_definition 2.15) went past the strongest MakeHuman body and looked unnatural (traps up to the ears, shoulders 1.15x an average man). A stays inside the MakeHuman data range: maximum muscle, ideal proportions, local targets about half of 002. Option B was rejected: chest abnormally large.
body_shape.muscle_targets_comment: 14/11 option A: local MakeHuman muscle targets at moderate weights; muscle separation comes from the layered muscle sculpt, not from more volume.

trapezius_volume.chosen: Kiệt chose level E on 15/11/2026 (docs/exercise-visual-system/trapezius_options.jpg, round 2): tall, prominent upper traps as on trained American and European lifters, neck still slim. Same character id: only the trapezius volume changed; every exercise is rebuilt on it (version 3.1.0).

faceless.comment: The frontal face (eyes, nose, mouth and their inner pockets) is cut out between the forehead and the chin and replaced by an evenly meshed surface. That surface is the front of the original head seen as a height field, with hollows narrower than fill_radius filled, bumps narrower than remove_radius removed, and a blur; it fades back into the original surface over rim_blend. Metres.

rig.comment: 53 game deform bones (Unreal-style names) plus anatomical helper bones from MPFB's default rig (14/11): shoulder blades, pectorals and twist bones, so the shoulder girdle and chest move like a real body and later exercises (rows, pull-ups, presses, curls) have the bones they need. Control bones (ctl_) and helper bones (mch_) are added by evs/rig.py and are never exported.

helper_bones.comment: Corrective helper bones (evs/helper_bones.py), Kiệt 15/11: traps get their own bone that follows the clavicle, and every deep-bending joint gets a half-rotation fold bone so the skin does not collapse or get dragged by the neighbouring group. Deform bones, constraint driven, exported (baked) like the twist bones.

folds.name: shoulder_fold_{s}
folds.why: The glenoid is on the shoulder blade and the deltoid arises from the scapular spine, acromion and clavicle, so the shoulder fold rides on the scapula (upward rotation) and turns half as far as the arm.

folds.name: thumb_fold_{s}
folds.why: The thenar web between thumb and index finger stretched 5x in every grip: the skin there was split between the hand and the second thumb bone.

smooth.name: crotch
smooth.why: The pelvis-to-thigh switch sat on a 4 mm strip at the midline, so 90 deg of hip flexion tore it 8-12x. Skin stretch across a fold is about arc length over band width; spreading the switch over 8 cm each side keeps it under 2.6x (measured on the seated press, 15/11).

grip.comment: The standard bar grip of this character: where a bar of this diameter sits in the palm when grip_l / grip_r is 1 (along_palm = metres from the wrist joint towards the knuckles; palm_depth = metres from the plane of the hand bones to the bar's surface; palm_surface = how far the skin of the hollow of the palm lies from that plane). The finger angles are solved once from these numbers when the rig is built: every finger closes onto the bar without its skin entering the bar or the palm. Exercises place their grip sockets with the same numbers, so hand and bar always agree. The pads of the palm are rigid in this rig, so the bar is set a few millimetres into them to stand for soft tissue pressed flat.
